companyDescription: Kidney-disease biotech · TRUTAKNA (atacicept) won FDA accelerated approval Jul 7, 2026 for high-risk IgA nephropathy · Phase 3 ORIGIN eGFR analysis moved up to Q3 2026 ahead of a Q4 sBLA for full approval
priceNote: Self-fetched today (no live-prices.json cache yet). Down 2.85% today, well off the 52-week high ($56.05) even after winning FDA accelerated approval for TRUTAKNA on Jul 7, 2026 — the market appears to be waiting for commercial launch execution and the Q3 confirmatory data before re-rating further.
summary: Vera already cleared its biggest hurdle: TRUTAKNA (atacicept) won FDA accelerated approval on Jul 7, 2026 to reduce proteinuria in high-risk IgA nephropathy — a real, completed regulatory win, not a pending binary. What's left is a genuine near-term confirmatory catalyst: Vera reached agreement with the FDA to move up the primary eGFR analysis from its ORIGIN Phase 3 trial to Q3 2026 (from a prior 2027 plan), setting up a Q4 2026 supplemental BLA filing for full (non-accelerated) approval. The 12-month consensus of $81.79 implies +127% from here, and the single highest named analyst target ($110, Buy rating) implies +205% — a real, disclosed figure, not a fabricated ceiling, though it sits well above the broader $56-110 range and shouldn't be treated as the base case.

catalysts.name: ORIGIN Phase 3 eGFR Analysis (moved up)
catalysts.description: Vera reached agreement with the FDA to accelerate the primary eGFR (kidney function) analysis from its ORIGIN Phase 3 trial to Q3 2026, ahead of the prior 2027 schedule — this data underpins the case for full (non-accelerated) approval.

catalysts.name: sBLA Filing for Full Approval
catalysts.description: Vera aims to file a supplemental Biologics License Application in Q4 2026 to convert TRUTAKNA's accelerated approval into full approval for IgA nephropathy, contingent on the Q3 eGFR data supporting it.

catalysts.name: TRUTAKNA Commercial Launch
catalysts.description: Already-approved commercial launch execution for TRUTAKNA in the accelerated-approval indication — the market's near-term read on how fast this converts into real prescriptions and revenue.

risks: The highest named target ($110, +205%) is a single-analyst figure well above the broader $56-110 range and the $81.79 average — treat it as a real but non-representative ceiling, not the expected case

The Q3 2026 eGFR analysis, while accelerated by FDA agreement, is still a real trial readout with binary risk — a disappointing result could delay or jeopardize the full-approval pathway even with accelerated approval already secured
Commercial launch execution for a newly-approved nephrology drug is genuinely uncertain — physician adoption, payer coverage, and real-world uptake all take time to become visible in the numbers
Down from the 52-week high ($56.05) even after the approval news — the market's muted reaction suggests real skepticism about near-term commercial ramp, not just profit-taking
$2.59B market cap is toward the larger end of names on this board — a smaller re-rate in dollar terms still requires a large percentage move given the current valuation

th.summary: Vera ผ่านด่านใหญ่ที่สุดไปแล้ว: TRUTAKNA (atacicept) ได้รับ FDA accelerated approval เมื่อ 7 ก.ค. 2026 เพื่อลด proteinuria ในผู้ป่วย IgA nephropathy ความเสี่ยงสูง — เป็นชัยชนะ regulatory จริงที่เกิดขึ้นแล้ว ไม่ใช่ binary ที่รออยู่ สิ่งที่เหลือคือ catalyst ยืนยันระยะใกล้จริง — Vera บรรลุข้อตกลงกับ FDA ให้เลื่อนการวิเคราะห์ eGFR หลักจาก Phase 3 ORIGIN มาเป็น Q3 2026 (จากแผนเดิมปี 2027) เตรียมยื่น supplemental BLA ใน Q4 2026 เพื่อขออนุมัติเต็มรูปแบบ (ไม่ใช่ accelerated) เป้า consensus 12 เดือนที่ $81.79 หมายถึง +127% จากราคานี้ และเป้าสูงสุดที่มีชื่อเดี่ยว ($110, Buy) หมายถึง +205% — เป็นตัวเลขจริงที่เปิดเผยแล้ว ไม่ใช่เพดานที่สร้างขึ้นเอง แม้จะอยู่สูงกว่า range กว้าง $56-110 มากและไม่ควรมองเป็น base case
